title: Area 51 crash: either secret US testing or intelligence watching nuclear tests

tellings.quote: when you start thinking Area 51 and the the crash and you've you've said this. I haven't done that research and I haven't looked into

plain: A crash linked to Area 51, the secret US air base in Nevada, may have been either secret American testing or some outside intelligence watching the nuclear bomb tests of the 1940s and 50s. Ralph Larson, a former CIA official, raises the two options while responding to the host, saying Jesse Michels has made this argument but that he himself has not researched it.
